sources.title: MiMo-V2.5-Pro release and open-weight announcement
sources.evidence: Current page is dated April 27, 2026. Names this exact model, nominal 1.02T total/42B active, MoE hybrid attention, 1M context, and coding/tool-use capabilities. The open-weight event is later than its first announcement.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.5-Pro official model card at pinned revision
sources.evidence: MIT metadata; exact post-trained model has nominal 1.02T/42B, 70 layers, 384 routed experts with top-8 selection, 60 sliding-window and 10 full-attention layers, and three dense-FFN MTP modules. Distinguishes Pro from Base and the multimodal non-Pro model.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.5-Pro checkpoint configuration
sources.evidence: Text causal decoder with hidden size 6144, 70 layers (one dense and 69 MoE), 384 experts/top-8 routing, 128-position SWA window, and max_position_embeddings=1048576. No image/audio encoder configuration. Mixed FP8; embeddings are not tied.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.5-Pro chat template
sources.evidence: Only text content is rendered. Template explicitly implements thinking on/off, reasoning content, tool definitions, XML function calls and tool responses.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.5-Pro official model implementation
sources.evidence: Language-token embeddings, decoder blocks and vocabulary output head; sparse MoE and hybrid attention implementation. Loader ignores model.mtp checkpoint keys, so enumerating this implementation alone would omit the published MTP modules. Quantization scales are not learned-weight counts.

sources.title: Official MiMo-V2.5-Pro repository metadata
sources.evidence: Public ungated checkpoint repository created 2026-04-27T12:52:53Z; inspected revision 21d1ecfecd7bd70f31be25ca49d7edd21f003659. Raw safetensors metadata sums mixed-dtype storage elements; that automated total is not used as a learned parameter count.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.5-Pro checkpoint tensor index
sources.evidence: Index maps 159581 tensors into 34 files, including three model.mtp.layers blocks in model_mtp.safetensors, separate input embeddings/output head, and many weight_scale_inv tensors. This is tensor-name coverage, not a full shape/module reconciliation.

sources.title: MiMo-V2.5 series open-weight license announcement
sources.evidence: Explicitly releases both V2.5 and Pro model weights, including Base, under MIT, permitting commercial deployment and further training. Separates public testing from April 23 from subsequent weight publication.

sources.title: XiaomiMiMo original V2.5 series announcement via X syndication
sources.evidence: Official XiaomiMiMo post explicitly introduces MiMo-V2.5-Pro. Timestamp is 2026-04-22T16:23:02Z, April 23 in Beijing. X main page returned 403; its public syndication response supplies author, timestamp and introductory text, but truncates the long post.

sources.title: Xiaomi model release changelog
sources.evidence: The exact mimo-v2.5-pro entry is dated April 23, 2026 and reports trillion-parameter scale, 42B active and 1M context. This Beijing calendar date is consistent with the April 22 UTC official announcement.

sources.title: Xiaomi model deprecation notice
sources.evidence: Explicitly states V2.5-Pro supports only text input; the V2.6-Pro replacement adds multimodal understanding. Documents October 14 routing to V2.6-Pro and October 21 identifier expiration. Table and prose disagree on the routing hour, so only dates are retained.

sources.title: Full-Pipeline Inference Optimization for MiMo-V2.5 Series
sources.evidence: First-party July 14 paper explicitly uses V2.5-Pro as the 70-layer example: 60 SWA/10 full attention, window 128. Describes three-layer MTP inference. Family-level multimodal sections do not establish visual/audio capability for Pro.

sources.title: XiaomiMiMo open-weight announcement via X syndication
sources.evidence: Official post timestamp 2026-04-27T17:48:09Z (April 28 Beijing) announces MIT release and explicitly names Pro among the two models. Long-post body is truncated; full weights-license terms are independently established by Xiaomi documentation.

name.note: Exact post-trained Pro checkpoint; distinct from V2-Pro, V2.5, Pro-Base and the UltraSpeed variant.

developer.note: Official Xiaomi MiMo announcement and checkpoint publisher agree.

release_date.note: Retain earliest official announcement date in UTC. The April 22 16:23 UTC post is April 23 in Beijing, matching the public-beta changelog. April 27 UTC concerns subsequent MIT weights, not the first model release.

open_weights.note: Exact checkpoint is public and ungated. Weights became available after the initial API/public-beta announcement.

license.note: Xiaomi explicitly applies MIT to these weights; not inferred solely from implementation code. No separate LICENSE file exists at the inspected checkpoint revision.

parameters_b.note: Author-reported rounded nominal model total, 1.02 trillion. This is not an exact learned-tensor count. Three MTP modules are present, but their separate contribution and rounding boundary are not reconciled; no extra subtotal is added. FP8 scale/storage elements are excluded from any claimed exact count, and no exact count is claimed.

active_parameters_b.note: Author-reported nominal active count for this exact model; top-8 expert routing is independently confirmed. This is not a measured per-step work count or a separately reconciled MTP-enabled inference total.

architecture.note: Decoder Transformer MoE with 69 MoE layers plus one dense layer; 384 experts, eight selected per token. Hybrid attention has 60 SWA and 10 full-attention layers, plus three MTP modules.

context_window.note: Exact checkpoint position limit is 1,048,576, advertised as 1M. Pro-Base has a different context limit. This describes model capacity rather than continued operation of the deprecated Xiaomi API identifier.

modalities.note: Text-only input and text generation. Xiaomi explicitly contrasts this with multimodal V2.6-Pro. Family-level multimodal discussion and API redirects must not be attributed to this historical checkpoint.

reasoning.note: Thinking mode and reasoning-content handling are explicit in the exact checkpoint template, with thinking enabled by default.

tool_call.note: Native tool definitions, structured function calls and tool responses are supported by the chat template; original announcement also demonstrates tool execution.

description.value: Text reasoning model with a mixture-of-experts architecture, tool calling and a 1M-token context window.
description.note: Replaces the unsupported multimodal claim and promotional tier phrasing with directly supported capabilities.

patch.description: Text reasoning model with a mixture-of-experts architecture, tool calling and a 1M-token context window.

patch.notes: Xiaomi reports rounded nominal totals of 1.02T parameters and 42B active; these are not exact tensor counts or a reconciled MTP breakdown. Original announcement: April 22, 2026 UTC, April 23 Beijing. MIT weights followed April 27 UTC. This checkpoint accepts and generates text; later multimodal API behavior belongs to V2.6-Pro. Xiaomi documents redirection on October 14 and API identifier expiration on October 21, 2026; public weights remain available.

summary: Verified all 14 fields. Adds MIT, nominal 1020B total/42B active and MoE; corrects the multimodal description to text-only. Retains April 22 after resolving the official April 23 Beijing date to the April 22 UTC announcement. Confirms 1,048,576 context, reasoning and tools; distinguishes later open weights and V2.6 API redirection. No exact learned-tensor count or unsupported component subtotal is asserted.
